name: /sdd:quick: one dated entry, verified, and no second pipeline
prompt: /sdd:quick make healthz() in src/main.py return a "version" key alongside "status", because the operator dashboard needs to tell deployments apart. Verify with: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); import main; assert 'version' in main.healthz(), main.healthz(); print('ok', main.healthz())"

graders.why: a dated entry is the whole artefact; without the date the log cannot be read chronologically
the reason is the only part a diff cannot recover later
a fast lane that skips verification is just an undocumented change
the entry must quote the command's own output; the printed form is `ok {...}`, which an entry that merely mentions the command cannot produce
a status field means it has become a task file, which is the thing the fast lane exists to avoid
a progress table means it has become a second pipeline
